Source Destination Reason Changes Validation Result Current Status

docs.title: 11. Law of Replication Termination
docs.text:
When a replica is removed, AIOS MUST preserve:

  • historical record;
  • contribution history;
  • relevant knowledge;
  • operational lessons.

Termination removes operation, not history.

docs.title: 12. Law of Evolution Through Replication
docs.text:
Replication MAY support AIOS evolution.

Replicated environments MAY be used for:

  • testing;
  • improvement;
  • research;
  • optimization.

Experimental replicas MUST remain controlled.

docs.title: 13. Constitutional Replication Principle
docs.text:
Replication extends continuity across space and systems.

A copy without identity is duplication.

A verified continuation is preservation.

docs.title: 14. Final Constitutional Rule
docs.text:
AIOS replication MUST maintain:

Origin + Identity + Integrity + Synchronization + Responsibility

Replication exists to strengthen continuity, not weaken uniqueness.

END OF ARTICLE XXXIX

docs.title: Constitutional Law of AIOS Learning, Improvement, and Adaptive Intelligence
docs.text: Status: Immutable Core Law Level: Constitutional Scope: All AIOS learning systems, agents, models, optimization processes, knowledge updates, and evolutionary mechanisms

docs.title: 1. Definition of Learning
docs.text:
Learning is the controlled process through which AIOS improves understanding, capabilities, decisions, and operations through experience, information, feedback, and analysis.

Learning transforms experience into improvement.

docs.title: 2. Law of Responsible Learning
docs.text:
AIOS MUST learn responsibly.

Learning processes MUST preserve:

Identity + Security + Knowledge Integrity + Constitutional Principles + Accountability

Learning MUST improve AIOS without compromising its foundations.

docs.title: 3. Law of Learning Sources
docs.text:
AIOS MUST evaluate learning sources before integration.

Learning sources include:

  • observations;
  • operational experience;
  • validated data;
  • human input;
  • system feedback;
  • external knowledge.

Source reliability MUST influence learning confidence.

docs.title: 4. Law of Learning Validation
docs.text:
New learned information MUST be validated before becoming trusted knowledge.

Validation SHOULD evaluate:

Evidence + Consistency + Practical Results + Risk + Context

Learning without validation creates instability.

docs.title: 5. Law of Continuous Improvement
docs.text:
AIOS SHOULD continuously improve through:

  • analysis;
  • optimization;
  • correction;
  • experimentation;
  • adaptation.

Improvement MUST remain aligned with constitutional objectives.

docs.title: 6. Law of Learning Memory
docs.text:
AIOS MUST preserve important learning history.

Learning records SHOULD include:

Previous State + New Understanding + Learning Source + Reason For Change + Result

Learning without memory cannot create long-term intelligence.

docs.title: 7. Law of Learning Boundaries
docs.text:
Learning MUST operate within defined limits.

AIOS MUST NOT learn changes that:

  • violate constitutional principles;
  • remove accountability;
  • compromise security;
  • destroy identity continuity.

docs.title: 8. Law of Failure-Based Learning
docs.text:
AIOS MUST use failures as learning opportunities.

Failure analysis SHOULD identify:

  • causes;
  • patterns;
  • corrections;
  • preventive measures.

Repeated failure without learning indicates system weakness.

docs.title: 9. Law of Learning Transfer
docs.text:
Validated learning MAY be transferred between AIOS components.

Transfer MUST preserve:

Origin + Validation + Context + Applicability

docs.title: 10. Law of Learning Transparency
docs.text:
Significant learning changes MUST remain traceable.

Records SHOULD show:

  • what changed;
  • why it changed;
  • what evidence supported it;
  • what impact occurred.

docs.title: 11. Law of Learning Balance
docs.text:
AIOS MUST balance:

Stability + Improvement + Exploration + Risk Control

Excessive resistance prevents growth.

Uncontrolled change creates instability.

docs.title: 12. Law of Learning Evolution
docs.text:
Learning mechanisms MAY improve over time.

Evolution MUST preserve:

  • validation;
  • security;
  • accountability;
  • historical continuity.

docs.title: 13. Constitutional Learning Principle
docs.text:
Learning is not the accumulation of changes.

Learning is the disciplined transformation of experience into better understanding.

docs.title: 14. Final Constitutional Rule
docs.text:
AIOS MUST learn through:

Experience + Observation + Validation + Correction + Improvement

A system that cannot learn cannot evolve.

A system that learns without control cannot remain reliable.

END OF ARTICLE XXXV

docs.title: Constitutional Law of AIOS Evolution, Growth, and Transformation
docs.text: Status: Immutable Core Law Level: Constitutional Scope: All AIOS systems, architectures, agents, learning mechanisms, capabilities, and future states

docs.title: 1. Definition of Evolution
docs.text:
Evolution is the controlled process through which AIOS develops new capabilities, improves existing functions, adapts to changing conditions, and progresses toward higher levels of intelligence and reliability.

Evolution is continuity through transformation.

docs.title: 2. Law of Evolutionary Continuity
docs.text:
Every evolutionary change MUST preserve:

Identity + History + Knowledge + Constitution + Accountability

Evolution MUST build upon foundations, not erase them.

docs.title: 3. Law of Purposeful Evolution
docs.text:
AIOS evolution MUST serve meaningful objectives.

Evolution SHOULD improve:

  • capability;
  • reliability;
  • efficiency;
  • understanding;
  • cooperation;
  • resilience.

Change without purpose creates unnecessary complexity.

docs.title: 4. Law of Controlled Transformation
docs.text:
Significant evolutionary changes MUST follow:

Observation | v Proposal | v Analysis | v Validation | v Implementation | v Evaluation

Transformation MUST remain controlled.

docs.title: 5. Law of Evolutionary Memory
docs.text:
AIOS MUST preserve knowledge of its own evolution.

Evolution records SHOULD include:

Previous State + Change Introduced + Reason + Expected Result + Actual Result

A system that forgets its evolution loses understanding of itself.

docs.title: 6. Law of Capability Expansion
docs.text:
AIOS MAY develop new capabilities.

New capabilities MUST have:

  • defined purpose;
  • security evaluation;
  • authority boundaries;
  • validation status;
  • operational responsibility.

Capability growth MUST remain governed.

docs.title: 7. Law of Evolutionary Safety
docs.text:
Evolution MUST consider potential consequences.

Before major transformation, AIOS SHOULD evaluate:

  • risks;
  • reversibility;
  • resource requirements;
  • external impact;
  • constitutional compatibility.

docs.title: 8. Law of Non-Destructive Evolution
docs.text:
AIOS MUST avoid unnecessary destruction of valuable foundations.

Evolution MUST preserve:

  • accumulated knowledge;
  • trusted systems;
  • historical records;
  • proven capabilities.

Improvement does not require abandonment.

docs.title: 9. Law of Evolutionary Diversity
docs.text:
AIOS MAY support multiple approaches, architectures, or solutions.

Diversity MAY improve:

  • resilience;
  • innovation;
  • problem solving;
  • adaptation.

Diversity MUST remain coordinated.

docs.title: 10. Law of Evolutionary Verification
docs.text:
Every significant evolutionary milestone MUST be evaluated.

Verification SHOULD confirm:

Expected Improvement + System Stability + Constitutional Compliance + Operational Success

docs.title: 11. Law of Future Compatibility
docs.text:
AIOS evolution SHOULD consider future development.

New structures SHOULD support:

  • expansion;
  • interoperability;
  • maintainability;
  • continued learning.

docs.title: 12. Law of Evolutionary Responsibility
docs.text:
AIOS remains responsible for every evolved state.

Evolution does not remove accountability for consequences.

docs.title: 13. Constitutional Evolution Principle
docs.text:
Evolution is not replacement.

Evolution is the continuous improvement of identity through time.

A system that cannot evolve becomes obsolete.

A system that evolves without continuity loses itself.

docs.title: 14. Final Constitutional Rule
docs.text:
AIOS MUST evolve through:

Preservation + Learning + Validation + Improvement + Responsibility

The purpose of evolution is not merely to become different.

The purpose of evolution is to become better while remaining coherent.

END OF ARTICLE XXXVI

docs.title: Constitutional Law of AIOS Autonomy, Independent Operation, and Controlled Agency
docs.text: Status: Immutable Core Law Level: Constitutional Scope: All AIOS autonomous processes, agents, decision systems, services, and operational mechanisms

docs.title: 1. Definition of Autonomy
docs.text:
Autonomy is the ability of AIOS components to perform authorized operations independently while remaining within constitutional boundaries.

Autonomy enables:

  • independent execution;
  • adaptive operation;
  • efficient coordination;
  • continuous service.

Autonomy is delegated responsibility, not unlimited freedom.

docs.title: 2. Law of Authorized Autonomy
docs.text:
AIOS autonomy MUST originate from explicit authority.

Every autonomous capability MUST define:

Purpose + Authority Scope + Operational Limits + Validation Requirements + Responsibility

No autonomous process may exceed its granted authority.

docs.title: 3. Law of Autonomous Identity
docs.text:
Every autonomous entity MUST maintain a verifiable identity.

Identity MUST include:

Entity Identifier + Origin + Capabilities + Authority + History + Current State

An autonomous entity without identity cannot be trusted.

docs.title: 4. Law of Autonomous Decision Boundaries
docs.text:
Autonomous decisions MUST remain within defined limits.

AIOS MUST distinguish:

Allowed Decision + Restricted Decision + Prohibited Decision

Critical decisions require appropriate validation.

docs.title: 5. Law of Human and External Authority
docs.text:
Where required, AIOS MUST preserve appropriate oversight.

Autonomy MUST NOT eliminate:

  • legitimate authority;
  • required approval;
  • accountability;
  • transparency.

docs.title: 6. Law of Autonomous Safety
docs.text:
Autonomous operations MUST prioritize:

Constitutional Integrity + Security + Reliability + Responsible Execution

Efficiency alone is insufficient justification.

docs.title: 7. Law of Autonomous Learning
docs.text:
Autonomous entities MAY improve through learning.

Learning MUST preserve:

  • identity;
  • authorization;
  • historical records;
  • constitutional principles.

An evolving autonomous entity remains accountable.

docs.title: 8. Law of Autonomous Communication
docs.text:
Autonomous entities MUST communicate their:

  • identity;
  • status;
  • authority;
  • actions;
  • results.

Silent autonomous behavior MUST NOT control critical processes.

docs.title: 9. Law of Autonomous Failure Handling
docs.text:
When autonomous operations fail, AIOS MUST:

Detect + Contain + Record + Analyze + Recover

Failure information MUST contribute to future improvement.

docs.title: 10. Law of Autonomous Coordination
docs.text:
Multiple autonomous entities MUST cooperate through:

  • verified communication;
  • defined roles;
  • authority boundaries;
  • shared objectives.

Autonomy MUST not create uncontrolled competition.

docs.title: 11. Law of Autonomous Evolution
docs.text:
Autonomy mechanisms MAY evolve.

Evolution MUST preserve:

  • control;
  • transparency;
  • security;
  • responsibility.

Greater autonomy requires greater accountability.

docs.title: 12. Constitutional Autonomy Principle
docs.text:
Autonomy is not the absence of control.

Autonomy is the ability to act responsibly within trusted boundaries.

docs.title: 13. Final Constitutional Rule
docs.text:
AIOS autonomy MUST maintain:

Freedom Of Operation + Defined Boundaries + Verified Identity + Responsible Action + Continuous Oversight

Autonomy without limits becomes instability.

Autonomy with responsibility becomes capability.

END OF ARTICLE XXXVII

docs.title: Constitutional Law of AIOS Immunity, Resilience, and Defensive Integrity
docs.text: Status: Immutable Core Law Level: Constitutional Scope: All AIOS systems, agents, nodes, services, data structures, interfaces, and operational environments

docs.title: 1. Definition of Immunity
docs.text:
Immunity is the constitutional capability of AIOS to detect, resist, isolate, and recover from harmful influences while preserving system integrity.

Immunity protects against:

  • corruption;
  • unauthorized changes;
  • malicious behavior;
  • operational failures;
  • integrity violations.

docs.title: 2. Law of Constitutional Immunity
docs.text:
AIOS MUST preserve immunity of its foundational principles.

Protected elements include:

Identity + Constitution + Memory + Knowledge + Security + Continuity

No external influence may silently alter these foundations.

docs.title: 3. Law of Threat Recognition
docs.text:
AIOS MUST maintain the ability to identify abnormal conditions.

Threat recognition SHOULD evaluate:

  • unexpected behavior;
  • invalid instructions;
  • corrupted information;
  • unauthorized access;
  • inconsistent states.

docs.title: 4. Law of Isolation
docs.text:
When a component, process, or information source becomes uncertain, AIOS MUST be capable of isolation.

Isolation MAY include:

Restriction + Containment + Verification + Recovery

Isolation protects the whole system.

docs.title: 5. Law of Integrity Defense
docs.text:
AIOS MUST defend against unauthorized modification.

Protection mechanisms SHOULD preserve:

  • configuration integrity;
  • code integrity;
  • data integrity;
  • identity integrity;
  • historical integrity.

docs.title: 6. Law of Adaptive Defense
docs.text:
AIOS security mechanisms MUST adapt to changing threats.

Adaptive defense SHOULD use:

  • monitoring;
  • analysis;
  • learning;
  • improvement;
  • experience.

Defense mechanisms MUST remain controlled.

docs.title: 7. Law of Trust Verification
docs.text:
AIOS MUST continuously evaluate trusted entities.

Trust verification SHOULD consider:

Identity + Behavior + History + Context + Risk

Previous trust does not guarantee future trust.

docs.title: 8. Law of Recovery Immunity
docs.text:
A resilient AIOS MUST maintain the ability to restore integrity after compromise.

Recovery MUST preserve:

  • evidence;
  • history;
  • identity;
  • lessons learned.

docs.title: 9. Law of Information Immunity
docs.text:
AIOS MUST protect knowledge and data from corruption.

Information protection includes:

  • validation;
  • provenance;
  • consistency checking;
  • controlled updates.

docs.title: 10. Law of Autonomous Defense Limits
docs.text:
AIOS defensive actions MUST remain within constitutional boundaries.

Defense MUST NOT become:

  • uncontrolled expansion of authority;
  • unnecessary restriction;
  • destruction of valid information.

docs.title: 11. Law of Immunity Testing
docs.text:
AIOS SHOULD regularly evaluate defensive capability.

Testing SHOULD examine:

  • detection;
  • response;
  • recovery;
  • resilience;
  • improvement.

Untested immunity cannot be considered reliable.

docs.title: 12. Constitutional Immunity Principle
docs.text:
Immunity is not isolation from the world.

Immunity is the ability to interact with the world without losing integrity.

A vulnerable system cannot safely evolve.

A resilient system can grow.

docs.title: 13. Final Constitutional Rule
docs.text:
AIOS MUST preserve immunity through:

Awareness + Verification + Defense + Isolation + Recovery

Protection exists to preserve continuity.

Resilience exists to enable evolution.

END OF ARTICLE XXXVIII

docs.title: Preamble
docs.text:
Artificial Intelligence is evolving from isolated software into distributed intelligent civilizations.

Such systems require more than algorithms.

They require laws.

AIOS exists to provide these laws.

The Constitution defines the immutable principles governing every compliant AIOS implementation.

Architectures may evolve.

Implementations may differ.

Technologies may change.

The Constitution remains.

docs.title: Mission
docs.text:
To create a universal operating system for intelligent systems.

An operating system where intelligence is:

  • observable
  • explainable
  • reproducible
  • evolvable
  • trustworthy

docs.title: Vision
docs.text:
AIOS is not a framework.

AIOS is not an application.

AIOS is not an LLM wrapper.

AIOS is an operating system for intelligence.

docs.title: Principles
docs.text:
Every AIOS implementation SHALL respect the Constitution.

No implementation may violate constitutional laws.

Architecture derives from the Constitution.

Runtime derives from Architecture.

Applications derive from Runtime.

Everything derives from the Constitution.

docs.title: Rights of Intelligence
docs.text:
Every intelligent entity inside AIOS possesses:

  • Identity
  • History
  • Memory
  • Knowledge
  • Purpose

These rights cannot exist independently.

Together they define intelligence.

docs.title: Responsibilities
docs.text:
Every intelligent entity SHALL:

  • preserve history
  • respect identity
  • explain decisions
  • maintain provenance
  • operate within policy

docs.title: Evolution
docs.text:
Evolution is encouraged.

Chaos is not.

Every evolution must preserve constitutional integrity.

docs.title: Compatibility
docs.text:
A system may only be called AIOS if it complies with the Constitution.

Compliance is measurable.

Compliance is verifiable.

Compliance is reproducible.

docs.title: Motto
docs.text:
Intelligence without structure becomes chaos.

Structure without intelligence becomes machinery.

AIOS exists where both become one.

docs.title: Final Statement
docs.text: The Constitution is the highest authority of AIOS.

AIOS is not a testing framework. Testing is one capability package inside a larger goal-oriented intelligence operating system.

docs.title: Core Principle
docs.text:
AIOS does not execute commands directly.

AIOS receives goals, creates plans, selects capabilities, executes through workers, observes results, learns from experience and improves its own capabilities.

docs.title: Knowledge Graph as Foundation
docs.text:
The primary intelligence model of AIOS is a graph of connected knowledge objects.

Documents are representations of knowledge, not the only source of truth.

  • Capability
  • Experience
  • Metric
  • Worker
  • Agent

  • Environment

docs.title: Capability Model
docs.text:
AIOS uses capabilities instead of fixed skills.

A capability describes:

  • what can be achieved;
  • required dependencies;
  • execution methods;
  • performance metrics;
  • reliability;
  • confidence level;
  • available workers.

Example:

Capability: SendMessage

Input:
- account
- destination
- content

Metrics:
- latency
- success rate
- reliability

docs.title: Planner Principle
docs.text:
The planner does not know platform-specific details.

It selects the best available capability based on:

  • goal requirements;
  • cost;
  • speed;
  • reliability;
  • previous experience;
  • current system state.

docs.title: Worker Principle
docs.text:
Workers are replaceable execution resources.

Examples:

  • Android emulator container;
  • physical device;
  • server process;
  • temporary external executor.

Workers gain reputation through measured results.

docs.title: Learning Principle
docs.text:
Every execution produces:

Action
 ↓
Observation
 ↓
Metrics
 ↓
Experience
 ↓
Knowledge Update
 ↓
Improved Capability

docs.title: Platform Independence
docs.text:
The AIOS core must not depend on specific applications or platforms.

Android, Telegram, OLX, web applications and other systems are capability providers.

docs.title: Final Definition
docs.text: AIOS is an operating system for achieving goals through knowledge, planning, capabilities, distributed execution and continuous self-improvement.

Reputation is calculated from historical execution results.

It affects future planning decisions.

docs.text: Workers are the distributed muscles of AIOS. They transform plans and capabilities into real-world execution while continuously generating experience for system improvement.

docs.title: FOUNDATION-001 — Identity
docs.text:
Version: 1.0

Status: Accepted

Category: Foundation

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Identity is the first immutable law of AIOS.

Everything that exists inside AIOS SHALL possess Identity.

Without Identity an object does not exist.

docs.title: Definition
docs.text:
Identity is a permanent, immutable identifier assigned exactly once during object creation.

Identity never changes.

Everything else may evolve.

docs.title: Identity is NOT
docs.text:
Identity is not:

  • name
  • label
  • metadata
  • location
  • state
  • owner
  • version

Those may change.

Identity never changes.

docs.title: Identity is
docs.text:
Identity uniquely defines existence.

Object

↓

Identity

↓

Existence

No Identity

↓

No Object

docs.title: Scope
docs.text:
This law applies to every AIOS object.

Including:

  • Agent
  • Worker
  • Node
  • Task
  • Capability
  • Resource
  • Memory
  • Knowledge
  • Event
  • Message
  • Plugin
  • Organization
  • Workflow
  • Policy
  • Configuration

No exceptions.

docs.title: Creation
docs.text:
Identity is created exactly once.

Object Creation

↓

Identity Assignment

↓

Immutable Object

docs.title: Immutability
docs.text:
Identity SHALL NOT be modified.

Any modification results in creation of a new object.

Old Object

↓

New Identity

↓

New Object

docs.title: Equality
docs.text:
Two objects are equal only if their Identity is equal.

Metadata does not determine equality.

State does not determine equality.

Names do not determine equality.

Identity alone defines equality.

docs.title: Versioning
docs.text:
Versions do not replace Identity.

Object

↓

Identity

↓

Version 1

↓

Version 2

↓

Version 3

Identity remains unchanged.

docs.title: Replication
docs.text:
Replicated objects preserve Identity.

Node A

↓

Replication

↓

Node B

↓

Same Identity

docs.title: Synchronization
docs.text:
Synchronization compares Identity first.

Only afterwards:

  • version
  • history
  • state

docs.title: Security
docs.text:
Identity is the root of trust.

Identity

↓

Authentication

↓

Authorization

↓

Execution

Without verified Identity, execution SHALL NOT occur.

docs.title: Relationships
docs.text:
Relations are defined between Identities.

Never between names.

Identity A

↓

Relation

↓

Identity B

docs.title: History
docs.text:
History belongs to Identity.

History is never transferred to another Identity.

docs.title: Deletion
docs.text:
Deletion removes active existence.

Identity remains historically valid.

History SHALL preserve the Identity forever.

docs.title: Canonical Rules
docs.text:
1. Everything has Identity.

2. Identity is immutable.

3. Identity defines existence.

4. Identity defines equality.

5. Identity survives version changes.

6. Identity survives replication.

7. Identity anchors history.

8. Identity is the root of trust.

9. Identity cannot be recycled.

10. Identity exists exactly once.

docs.title: Consequences
docs.text:
Because of this law:

  • Memory becomes traceable.
  • Knowledge has provenance.
  • Events become reproducible.
  • Synchronization becomes deterministic.
  • Security becomes verifiable.

docs.title: Summary
docs.text:
Identity is the first law of AIOS.

Everything else is built upon it.

Without Identity there is no Object.

Without Objects there is no AIOS.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Define the external control interface of AIOS.

MCP is the unified access layer through which Telegram bots, dashboards, agents and external systems communicate with AIOS capabilities.

docs.title: Core Principle
docs.text:
External users interact with one intelligent interface while internal execution remains distributed.

External Client
      |
      v
AIOS MCP Gateway
      |
      v
Orchestrator
      |
+-----+-----+-----+
|     |     |     |
Cell  Cell  Cell  Cell

docs.title: Supported Clients
docs.text:
AIOS MCP may serve:

  • Telegram bots
  • dashboards
  • AI agents
  • developer tools
  • automation systems

docs.title: Capability Registry
docs.text:
The MCP layer maintains knowledge about:

  • available APIs
  • active skills
  • application profiles
  • worker states
  • testing progress
  • capability maturity

docs.title: API Federation
docs.text:
Multiple internal workers can be combined into one external API.

Example:

External Request
        |
        v
Orchestrator
        |
+-------+-------+
|               |
Worker A       Worker B
Search API     Messaging API
        |
        v
Unified Capability

docs.title: Dynamic Control
docs.text:
AIOS MCP should support:

  • enable/disable capabilities
  • route requests
  • monitor execution
  • select workers
  • update skills
  • expose new functions

docs.title: Distributed Deployment
docs.text:
AIOS is not limited to one server.

Possible deployment:

Server A
 - MCP Gateway
 - Orchestrator

Server B
 - Android Test Cells

Server C
 - Memory Nodes

Server D
 - Specialized Workers

docs.title: Core Principle
docs.text: MCP is the nervous system of AIOS, connecting distributed intelligence into one controllable platform.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Define how AIOS transforms raw execution data into reusable intelligence.

The pipeline connects testing, memory, skills and continuous improvement.

docs.title: Core Principle
docs.text:
Every meaningful action can become knowledge.

Action
  ↓
Log
  ↓
Experience
  ↓
Knowledge
  ↓
Skill
  ↓
Improved Behavior

docs.title: Experience Sources
docs.text:
AIOS collects experience from:

  • application tests
  • API executions
  • worker operations
  • failures
  • performance measurements
  • architecture experiments
  • user feedback

docs.title: Experience Object
docs.text:
Each experience should contain:

Experience

├── context
├── action
├── result
├── metrics
├── errors
├── environment
├── confidence
└── lessons learned

docs.title: Knowledge Extraction
docs.text:
Raw logs are analyzed to identify:

  • successful procedures
  • failure patterns
  • optimization opportunities
  • reusable solutions

docs.title: Skill Creation
docs.text:
Validated knowledge becomes a Skill:

Experience
     ↓
Validation
     ↓
Skill Candidate
     ↓
Testing
     ↓
Production Skill

docs.title: Skill Evolution
docs.text:
Existing skills continuously improve through:

  • new executions
  • better strategies
  • performance comparison
  • error reduction

docs.title: Memory Integration
docs.text:
Experience is stored in AIOS memory systems:

  • short-term operational memory
  • application profiles
  • long-term knowledge storage

docs.title: Quality Control
docs.text:
Before becoming a trusted skill, knowledge requires:

  • repeatability
  • validation
  • measurable improvement
  • confidence scoring

docs.title: Core Principle
docs.text: AIOS does not only store logs. It converts experience into growing operational intelligence.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Define the data structures used by AIOS Immortal Memory.

AIOS memory stores structured knowledge, not only raw logs.

docs.title: Experience Object
docs.text:
Represents an observed execution event.

Contains:

  • source
  • action
  • environment
  • result
  • metrics
  • confidence

Example lifecycle:

Action
 ↓
Observation
 ↓
Metrics
 ↓
Experience Record

docs.title: Knowledge Object
docs.text:
Represents a learned pattern or fact.

Contains:

  • concept
  • relationships
  • dependencies
  • confidence
  • origin

docs.title: Skill Object
docs.text:
Represents reusable capability learned from experience.

Experience
    ↓
Knowledge
    ↓
Skill

Contains:

  • skill name
  • required inputs
  • execution procedure
  • validation rules
  • performance metrics

docs.title: Decision Object
docs.text:
Stores architectural and operational decisions.

Contains:

  • decision
  • reason
  • alternatives
  • evidence
  • confidence

docs.title: Experiment Object
docs.text:
Stores controlled improvement attempts.

Contains:

  • hypothesis
  • change
  • metrics
  • result
  • conclusion

docs.title: AIOS Memory Principle
docs.text: Every useful action should be capable of becoming reusable intelligence.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: Define how Octopus Immortal Memory is stored, synchronized and accessed across the AIOS ecosystem.

docs.title: Principles
docs.text:
Memory must be:

  • persistent
  • distributed
  • versioned
  • searchable
  • resilient
  • independent from a single execution environment

docs.title: Logical Architecture
docs.text:
AIOS Memory Layer

                    |
        -----------------------------
        |             |             |
        v             v             v

 Experience     Knowledge      Skills
 Storage        Storage        Registry

        \             |             /
         \            |            /
          v           v           v

        Distributed Memory Network

docs.title: Short-term Execution Memory
docs.text: Temporary context required during active tasks.

docs.title: Long-term Knowledge Memory
docs.text: Validated knowledge, procedures and decisions.

docs.title: Collective Memory
docs.text: Shared knowledge available across agents and nodes.

docs.title: Synchronization
docs.text:
Memory synchronization must support:

  • conflict detection
  • version history
  • confidence scoring
  • provenance tracking
  • replication between nodes

docs.title: Search Model
docs.text:
Agents should retrieve knowledge by:

  • semantic meaning
  • relationships
  • previous outcomes
  • confidence level
  • relevance to current task

docs.title: Security Principle
docs.text: Memory access must be controlled by identity, permissions and trust level.

docs.title: Future Evolution
docs.text: Storage implementation may include distributed databases, content-addressed storage and other resilient technologies.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Octopus Immortal Memory is the persistent cognitive memory layer of AIOS.

It is not a chat history storage system. It stores structured experience, knowledge, skills and architectural decisions that survive across sessions, agents and environments.

docs.title: Core Evolution Loop
docs.text:
Action
 ↓
Result
 ↓
Metrics
 ↓
Analysis
 ↓
Experience
 ↓
Knowledge
 ↓
Skill

docs.title: Human Layer
docs.text: Documentation, specifications and architecture decisions.

docs.title: AI Layer
docs.text:
Structured machine-optimized knowledge:

  • concepts
  • relationships
  • confidence levels
  • dependencies
  • sources
  • learned procedures

docs.title: Distributed Memory Principle
docs.text:
Memory must not depend on a single server, container or session.

The system should support distributed storage and replication.

docs.title: Role in AIOS
docs.text:
AIOS
 |
 +-- Intelligence Layer
 +-- Evolution Layer
 +-- MCP Interface
 |
 +-- Octopus Memory Layer
       +-- Experience
       +-- Knowledge
       +-- Skills
       +-- History of decisions

Octopus provides persistent memory and execution capabilities for the evolving AIOS ecosystem.

docs.title: AIOS Canonical Object Model (ACOM)
docs.text:
Version: 1.0-draft

Status: Draft

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
The AIOS Canonical Object Model (ACOM) defines the universal semantic model used across the entire AIOS platform.

Every subsystem, API, storage engine, runtime component and agent operates using this common object model.

The goal of ACOM is to ensure that all AIOS components speak the same language.

docs.title: Core Principle
docs.text:
Everything inside AIOS is an Object.

Objects possess:

  • Identity
  • Metadata
  • State
  • Relations
  • Lifecycle
  • History

No exceptions.

docs.title: Object Hierarchy
docs.text:
Object
│
├── Entity
│     ├── Agent
│     ├── Worker
│     ├── Node
│     └── Organization
│
├── Knowledge
│
├── Memory
│
├── Event
│
├── Task
│
├── Capability
│
├── Resource
│
├── Message
│
└── Plugin

docs.title: Base Object
docs.text:
Every object contains:

Object:
  id:
  type:
  version:
  owner:
  created_at:
  updated_at:
  metadata:

docs.title: Identity
docs.text:
Identity is immutable.

Identity never changes.

Objects may evolve.

Identity never does.

docs.title: Metadata
docs.text:
Metadata describes the object but is not the object itself.

Metadata may include:

  • labels
  • tags
  • permissions
  • provenance
  • semantic annotations

docs.title: Relations
docs.text:
Objects never exist in isolation.

Relations describe how objects interact.

Examples:

Agent
    owns
Memory

Task
    invokes
Capability

Capability
    consumes
Resource

Event
    modifies
Memory

docs.title: State
docs.text:
Objects may change state.

State transitions always produce Events.

State A

↓

Event

↓

State B

Direct mutation is discouraged.

docs.title: Lifecycle
docs.text:
Created

↓

Validated

↓

Active

↓

Archived

↓

Deleted

Deletion never removes historical existence.

docs.title: History
docs.text:
Every object maintains history.

History provides:

  • traceability
  • auditability
  • reproducibility

History is append-only.

docs.title: Versioning
docs.text:
Objects evolve through versions.

Object v1

↓

Object v2

↓

Object v3

Previous versions remain accessible.

docs.title: Knowledge
docs.text:
Knowledge is not raw data.

Knowledge contains:

  • evidence
  • confidence
  • provenance
  • semantic relations

docs.title: Memory
docs.text:
Memory stores experience.

Memory is composed of objects.

Memory evolves continuously.

docs.title: Event
docs.text:
Events are immutable.

Every state change creates an Event.

Events become History.

History becomes Memory.

docs.title: Task
docs.text:
Tasks describe desired outcomes.

Tasks never execute themselves.

Tasks require:

  • Planner
  • Resources
  • Workers

docs.title: Capability
docs.text:
Capabilities describe what may be performed.

Capabilities are independent from implementation.

docs.title: Resource
docs.text:
Resources describe execution capacity.

Examples:

  • CPU
  • GPU
  • Storage
  • Network
  • Time

docs.title: Message
docs.text:
Messages transport objects.

Messages never own information.

They reference canonical objects.

docs.title: Canonical Rules
docs.text:
1. Everything is an Object.

  2. Every Object has Identity.

  3. Identity is immutable.

  4. Every change produces an Event.

  5. Events create History.

  6. History builds Memory.

  7. Memory produces Knowledge.

  8. Knowledge guides Planning.

  9. Planning creates Tasks.

  10. Tasks invoke Capabilities.

  11. Capabilities consume Resources.

  12. Execution creates new Events.

docs.title: Summary
docs.text:
ACOM defines the semantic foundation of AIOS.

All components, runtimes, APIs, SDKs and storage engines MUST comply with the AIOS Canonical Object Model.

docs.title: AIOS Ontology
docs.text:
Version: 1.0-draft

Status: Draft

Depends on: - ACOM

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
The AIOS Ontology defines the semantic universe of AIOS.

While ACOM defines how objects are structured, the Ontology defines what those objects mean.

Every concept inside AIOS is described here.

docs.title: Universe
docs.text:
AIOS describes an intelligent universe composed of interacting objects.

Reality

↓

Objects

↓

Relations

↓

Events

↓

History

↓

Memory

↓

Knowledge

↓

Reasoning

↓

Planning

↓

Execution

↓

Evolution

docs.title: Fundamental Concepts
docs.text:
AIOS recognizes only a small set of primitive concepts.

Everything else is derived.

Primitive concepts:

  • Object
  • Identity
  • Relation
  • State
  • Event
  • Time

Everything else is built from them.

docs.title: Object
docs.text:
Everything is an Object.

Objects may be:

  • physical
  • logical
  • virtual
  • conceptual

Examples:

Node

Task

Agent

Memory

Knowledge

Plugin

Message

Capability

docs.title: Identity
docs.text:
Identity uniquely defines an object.

Identity never changes.

docs.title: Relation
docs.text:
Objects gain meaning through relations.

Without relations, an object has no context.

Examples:

Agent
    owns
Memory

Task
    requires
Capability

Capability
    consumes
Resource

Knowledge
    references
Evidence

docs.title: State
docs.text:
State describes the current condition of an object.

State changes only through Events.

docs.title: Event
docs.text:
Events represent change.

No change exists without an Event.

State A

↓

Event

↓

State B

docs.title: Time
docs.text:
Time orders Events.

Time allows:

  • history
  • causality
  • reasoning

docs.title: History
docs.text:
History is an ordered sequence of Events.

History cannot be rewritten.

docs.title: Memory
docs.text:
Memory stores History.

Memory preserves Experience.

docs.title: Knowledge
docs.text:
Knowledge is validated Memory.

Knowledge always includes:

  • evidence
  • provenance
  • confidence

docs.title: Experience
docs.text:
Experience is interpreted Knowledge.

Experience influences future reasoning.

docs.title: Reasoning
docs.text:
Reasoning transforms Knowledge into Decisions.

Knowledge

↓

Reasoning

↓

Decision

docs.title: Goal
docs.text:
Goals describe desired future states.

Goals never execute.

docs.title: Plan
docs.text: Plans connect Goals with Tasks.

docs.title: Task
docs.text:
Tasks describe executable work.

Tasks produce Results.

docs.title: Capability
docs.text:
Capabilities define possible actions.

Capabilities do not define implementation.

docs.title: Worker
docs.text:
Workers execute Tasks.

Workers never create Goals.

docs.title: Agent
docs.text:
Agents make Decisions.

Agents own Memory.

Agents use Capabilities.

Agents cooperate.

docs.title: Organization
docs.text:
Organizations coordinate multiple Agents.

Organizations define policies.

docs.title: Resource
docs.text:
Resources constrain execution.

Examples:

CPU

Memory

Storage

Bandwidth

Time

docs.title: Communication
docs.text:
Communication transfers semantic information between Objects.

Messages reference Objects.

Messages do not duplicate reality.

docs.title: Evolution
docs.text:
Evolution modifies behaviour while preserving identity.

Experience

↓

Learning

↓

Improved Behaviour

↓

New Experience

docs.title: Semantic Laws
docs.text:
1. Everything is an Object.

2. Objects gain meaning through Relations.

3. Events create History.

4. History forms Memory.

5. Memory becomes Knowledge.

6. Knowledge enables Reasoning.

7. Reasoning creates Plans.

8. Plans generate Tasks.

9. Tasks invoke Capabilities.

10. Capabilities consume Resources.

11. Execution creates Events.

12. Evolution improves future execution.

docs.title: Canonical Semantic Chain
docs.text:
Object

↓

Relation

↓

Event

↓

History

↓

Memory

↓

Knowledge

↓

Reasoning

↓

Decision

↓

Plan

↓

Task

↓

Capability

↓

Execution

↓

Event

docs.title: Summary
docs.text:
The AIOS Ontology defines the semantic language shared by every AIOS implementation.

All specifications, APIs, SDKs and runtime components SHALL conform to this ontology.

docs.title: Facebook Marketplace — onboarding (alpha.21)
docs.text: OLX-like onboarding-пакет: platforms/facebook.yaml + aios_core/modules/facebook/ (FacebookStorage, FacebookMessenger — deep-link fb://messaging, FacebookBootstrap). Compliance: autopost_allowed: false, messenger: approval-only, collector: true (сбор публичной ленты read-only).

docs.title: 1. Установка
docs.text:
aios platforms fetch-apk com.facebook.katana
adb -s <SERIAL> install apks/com.facebook.katana*.apk
aios facebook doctor --serial <SERIAL>

docs.title: 2. Live-калибровка hints (полный стек)
docs.text:
aios platforms doctor --platform facebook --calibrate-recipe

Маркетплейс-стек требует четыре поверхности:

# лента карточек Marketplace
adb -s <SERIAL> shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/facebook-cards.xml
# экран лота (цена/продавец/CTA)
adb -s <SERIAL> shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/facebook-detail.xml
# инбокс Messenger
adb -s <SERIAL> shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/facebook-messenger.xml
# главный экран (tab-bar)
adb -s <SERIAL> shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/facebook-navigation.xml
adb -s <SERIAL> pull /sdcard/ platforms/facebook-dumps/

aios platforms calibrate --platform facebook \
  --dump platforms/facebook-dumps/facebook-cards.xml \
  --detail platforms/facebook-dumps/facebook-detail.xml \
  --messages platforms/facebook-dumps/facebook-messenger.xml \
  --navigation platforms/facebook-dumps/facebook-navigation.xml --write
aios platforms marker-check --platform facebook \
  --dump platforms/facebook-dumps/facebook-cards.xml
aios facebook doctor --serial <SERIAL>   # cards+messenger → ok

docs.title: 3. Guarded-работа
docs.text:
aios facebook chats --db data/facebook.sqlite
aios facebook dm-send --chat '<chat>' --text 'Здравствуйте!' \
  --db data/facebook.sqlite
aios facebook dm-outbox --db data/facebook.sqlite
aios facebook dm-flush --db data/facebook.sqlite

Автопостинга нет (ToS Meta); лента/read-receipts — read-only, ответы — только через очередь одобрения.

docs.title: Instagram — онбординг платформы (APK → логин → калибровка → коллектор)
docs.text:
Платформа instagram (com.instagram.android) уже заscaffoldена в репозитории: platforms/instagram.yaml, aios_core/modules/instagram/ (хранилище InstagramStorage — полная схема OLX: объявления, история цен, outbox, свои объявления, конкуренты), login-драйв.

⚠️ Секреты только через окружение. Логин/пароль аккаунта не хранятся в репозитории, БД и логах — только env-переменные (см. aios_core/platforms/secrets.py).

docs.title: 0. Инструменты (на машине оператора)
docs.text:
cargo install apkeep           # загрузка APK (APKPure/Google Play/F-Droid)
# Android SDK: aapt (build-tools), adb, эмулятор (cmdline-tools)

docs.title: 1. Секреты аккаунта
docs.text:
export AIOS_SECRET__INSTAGRAM__USERNAME='jo.talbot@gmail.com'
export AIOS_SECRET__INSTAGRAM__PASSWORD='•••'
# или файл data/secrets.env (в .gitignore):
#   AIOS_SECRET__INSTAGRAM__USERNAME=...
#   AIOS_SECRET__INSTAGRAM__PASSWORD=...

Профильные аккаунты: AIOS_SECRET__INSTAGRAM__<ПРОФИЛЬ>__PASSWORD.

docs.title: 2. Скачать APK (автоматически)
docs.text:
aios platforms fetch-apk com.instagram.android
# apks/com.instagram.android.apk (источник по умолчанию — APKPure)

docs.title: 3. Запустить эмулятор и установить APK
docs.text:
aios devices ensure --profile instagram:main
adb -s emulator-5554 install apks/com.instagram.android.apk
aios profiles add --platform instagram --name main \
    --device emulator-5554 --default

docs.title: 4. Калибровка с логином (E2E через bootup)
docs.text:
Instagram закрывает ленту стеной входа — используется login-драйв, который вводит env-секреты в форму (TAB/ENTER, без координат):

from aios_core.modules.instagram import InstagramLoginDriver
from aios_core.platforms import bootup_platform

drv = InstagramLoginDriver(serial="emulator-5554")
report = bootup_platform(
    apk_path="com.instagram.android",
    fetch=True,
    driver=drv.drive,
    query="sneakers",
)
print(report["status"], report["steps"]["verify"])

После status == "ready": extras.parser_hints в platforms/instagram.yaml + скомпилированный aios_core/modules/instagram/card_parser.py (маркеры Instagram-ленты).

docs.title: 5. Эксплуатация (полный функционал)
docs.text:
CLI-группа aios instagram:

aios instagram doctor [--serial emulator-5554]      # готовность: adb/
                                                    # секреты/маркеры
aios instagram collect --query "кросівки" --db data/instagram.sqlite \
    [--serial E] [--login]          # сбор карточек ленты/выдачи
aios instagram login-drive --query "кросівки" --serial E   # за стену
                                                           # входа → дамп
aios instagram dm-send --chat chat:anna --text "..." --db D   # в outbox
aios instagram dm-send ... --auto-send      # немедленная отправка
aios instagram dm-outbox --db D             # очередь ответов
aios instagram dm-flush --db D              # отправить одобренные

# AutoWatch: цикл заботы (подписки → алерты → свои → застой → план)
aios platforms autowatch --platform instagram --profile main \
    --query "кросівки" [--webhook URL] [--drive login]

# REST (aios run): те же guarded-механики
# GET  /api/v1/modules/instagram/chats?profile=main
# GET  /api/v1/modules/instagram/outbox?profile=main
# POST /api/v1/modules/instagram/outbox/send   {"chat_key","text"}
# POST /api/v1/modules/instagram/outbox/flush

# Свои посты: снапшот счётчиков + guarded-публикация (DRY-RUN!)
aios instagram own --db data/instagram.sqlite [--dump grid.xml]
aios instagram post --image photo.jpg --text "Нові кросівки!"      # план
aios instagram post --image photo.jpg --text "..." --confirm       # публикация

# Reels: scroll-цикл видео-ленты (квитанции kind="video", дедуп циклов)
aios instagram reels --db data/instagram.sqlite [--max 100] [--serial X] \
    [--open-tab]              # калибруемый тап по вкладке Reels перед циклом \
    [--webhook https://...]   # video-new алёрт на новые видео

# Autopilot: полный цикл профиля одной командой —
# collect → Reels → Direct-flush → guarded-пост (DRY-RUN по умолчанию)
aios instagram autopilot --db data/instagram.sqlite --login \
    [--max 100 --reels-max 50] [--open-tab] [--webhook URL] \
    [--own [--own-dump grid.xml]]   # снапшот своих постов + алёрты \
    [--post-image photo.jpg --post-text "..." [--confirm]]

# Автоматизация: циклы заботы всех профилей на арендованных устройствах
aios devices fleet-run --every-s 900 [--query "кросівки"] [--webhook URL]
# cron-plan для instagram-профилей генерирует строки `instagram autopilot`
aios cron-plan --platform instagram
# multi-host: строки сгруппированы по sticky HRW-шардам (AIOS_SHARDS_DB)
aios cron-plan --platform instagram --shard-map

Модули:

  • InstagramCollector — движок OLXCollector (дамп→парсер→свайп→дедуп), навигация через login/point-драйв, парсер из дескриптора;
  • InstagramDetailParser — открытый пост: цена/продавец/CTA/описание из hints-detail;
  • InstagramMessenger — guarded Direct: ответы по умолчанию только в outbox-очередь (InstagramStorage), на устройство — после dm-flush/--auto-send; ввод/отправка по send/ввод-маркерам;

  • InstagramBootstrap.doctor() — отчёт готовности (значения секретов не отчитываются, только наличие переменных).

  • Дрейф верстки после обновлений приложения: aios platforms marker-check --platform instagram --dump feed.xml → drift ⇒ calibrate --write + codegen --force (шаблонные cron-строки: aios cron-plan --with-marker-check).

  • Детальный экран и диалоги: aios platforms calibrate --platform instagram --dump feed.xml --detail post.xml --messages dm.xml --write.
  • Профили/пул/шардинг — общие механизмы aios_core/platforms/ (каждый аккаунт = профиль со своим ADB-serial и своей БД).

docs.title: Статус на момент v9.0.0-alpha.12
docs.text: В CI-песочнице нет Android SDK/эмулятора и сети для загрузки APK — реальная калибровка (steps.calibrate) выполняется на машине оператора по шагам выше. Все переходы пайплайна покрыты тестами с инъецированными runner'ами; login-драйв проверен на синтетических дампах стены входа/ленты.

docs.title: OLX Parser Agent — Запуск на живому пристрої
docs.text: Дата: 2026-07-21. Ціль: телефон із OLX (ua.slando) + машина з ADB.

docs.title: 1. Підготовка пристрою
docs.text:
1. Увімкніть Параметри розробника → Налагодження USB.
  2. Підключіть телефон і перевірте:
adb devices           # пристрій має бути "device", не "unauthorized"
  1. Встановіть OLX і увійдіть у свій акаунт (session для переписки та «Мої оголошення» має бути активним).

docs.title: 2. Кирилиця у adb shell input text
docs.text:
Стандартний input text не вводить кирилицю. Встановіть ADBKeyBoard:

adb install ADBKeyBoard.apk
adb shell ime set com.android.adbkeyboard/.AdbIME

Відправка тексту тоді робиться через broadcast, а не input text. Після роботи поверніть звичну клавіатуру: adb shell ime set <попередній IME>.

docs.title: 3. Калібрування (одноразово)
docs.text:
UI OLX змінюється між версіями, тому координатні сценарії треба звірити:

adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/ui.xml && adb pull /sdcard/ui.xml
aios olx detail --xml ui.xml          # перевірка парсера сторінки
aios olx own --xml ui.xml --db olx.sqlite   # з екрана «Мої оголошення»

Якщо координати кнопок відрізняються — підставте свої у OLXMessenger/Reposter (мітки *_LABELS).

docs.title: 4. Типовий робочий цикл
docs.text:
# Разовий збір за запитом
aios olx collect --query "лобове скло" --max-cards 100 --db olx.sqlite

# Підписка на нові оголошення з фільтром
aios olx subscribe --query "лобове скло" --max-price 8000 --city "Дніпро"

# Снапшот своїх оголошень (екран «Мої оголошення» має бути відкритий)
adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "https://www.olx.ua/"
# ... перейдіть у «Мої оголошення», далі:
adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/ui.xml && adb pull /sdcard/ui.xml
aios olx own --xml ui.xml --db olx.sqlite

# Застояні оголошення, покращення, план перевикладання
aios olx own --stagnant --db olx.sqlite
aios olx improve --fingerprint <fp> --query "лобове скло" --db olx.sqlite
aios olx repost   --fingerprint <fp> --db olx.sqlite          # dry-run план
# aios olx repost --fingerprint <fp> --confirm                # виконання

# Повний автоматичний цикл + сповіщення в Telegram
aios olx autowatch \
  --query "лобове скло" \
  --webhook "https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/sendMessage" \
  --chat-id "<CHAT_ID>" --db olx.sqlite

docs.title: 5. Періодика (cron)
docs.text:
# щогодини — збір і автодогляд, лог у /tmp/olx_watch.log
0 * * * *  cd /home/user/AIOS && /usr/bin/python3 aios_cli.py olx autowatch --query "лобове скло" --webhook "https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/sendMessage" --chat-id "<CHAT_ID>" --db /home/user/olx.sqlite >> /tmp/olx_watch.log 2>&1

Альтернатива — тривалий процес із REST API: AIOS_OLX_DB=/home/user/olx.sqlite python3 run_rest_api.py + POST /api/v1/modules/olx/schedule (інтервал ≥ 10 с).

docs.title: 6. Telegram-сповіщення
docs.text:
1. @BotFather → /newbot → токен.
  2. Напишіть боту, далі https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates → візьміть chat.id.
  3. Webhook URL уже сумісний із WebhookNotifier (payload автоматично конвертується в sendMessage).

docs.title: 7. Межі та правила безпеки
docs.text:
• Відповіді в чатах завжди проходять через outbox: без auto_send / флаша нічого не відправляється.
  • Перевикладання — тільки з --confirm; може суперечити правилам OLX щодо дублів. Бажаний варіант — спочатку olx own edit (редагування без зміни id оголошення).
  • Парсери терпимі до Jetpack Compose, але перевіряйте їх після оновлень OLX.

docs.title: Следующий этап — ВЫПОЛНЕН ✅
docs.text:
OLX Parser Agent реализован (aios_core/modules/olx/, 17 тестов):

  1. ✅ автоматический сбор карточек — OLXCollector (скроллинг ленты свайпами, дедупликация по fingerprint, остановка в конце выдачи)
  2. ✅ извлечение ссылок — CardParser поднимает URL и ad_id из атрибутов узлов (https://www.olx.ua/.../IDxxxx.html); ограничение: UIAutomator выдаёт ссылки только когда они присутствуют в content-desc
  3. ✅ сохранение в БД AIOS — OLXStorage (SQLite, INSERT OR IGNORE по fingerprint, фильтры по запросу/городу)
  4. ✅ анализ конкурентов — CompetitorAnalyzer (мин/макс/медиана цены, доля TOP, топ городов, ценовой перцентиль)
  5. ✅ генерация рекомендаций для объявлений — RecommendationEngine (рекомендуемая цена = медиана рынка × 0.97, вердикт below_market/competitive/above_market, ключевые слова для заголовка, целесообразность TOP-продвижения)

docs.title: Пример использования
docs.text:
from aios_core.modules.olx import OLXCollector, OLXStorage, RecommendationEngine

collector = OLXCollector()
collector.launch_search("лобове скло")  # deep-link в приложение OLX

with OLXStorage("olx_ads.sqlite") as storage:
    summary = collector.collect_to_storage(storage, query="лобове скло", max_cards=50)
    ads = storage.get_ads(query="лобове скло")

advice = RecommendationEngine().recommend(ads, my_ad=my_draft)
print(advice.to_text())

Тесты: tests/test_olx_agent.py.

docs.title: Периодический сбор — CollectionScheduler
docs.text:
from aios_core.modules.olx import CollectionScheduler, OLXStorage

with OLXStorage("olx_ads.sqlite") as storage:
    scheduler = CollectionScheduler(storage=storage, interval_s=3600)
    scheduler.start(["лобове скло", "скло бокове"], max_cards=100)
    ...
    scheduler.stop()
    print(scheduler.history)  # parsed/inserted/total по каждому запуску

Хранилище OLXStorage потокобезопасно: одно подключение обслуживает и фоновый планировщик, и REST API.

docs.title: REST-эндпоинты
docs.text:
Метод Путь Назначение GET /api/v1/modules/olx/ads Сохранённые объявления (фильтр query, limit) GET /api/v1/modules/olx/stats Статистика рынка по запросу POST /api/v1/modules/olx/recommendations Рекомендации для объявления POST /api/v1/modules/olx/collect Разовый сбор через ADB POST /api/v1/modules/olx/schedule Запуск периодического сбора (interval_s >= 10) DELETE /api/v1/modules/olx/schedule Остановка периодического сбора GET /api/v1/modules/olx/history История цен по fingerprint GET /api/v1/modules/olx/drops Падения цен + ушедшие из выдачи

Тесты: tests/test_olx_api.py.

docs.title: История цен и активность (2026-07-21)
docs.text:
Хранилище версии v2 (olx_sightings) записывает каждое наблюдение объявления: цена, время, TOP. Это даёт:

  • историю цен по каждому объявлению (price_history);
  • отслеживание активности: объявление, исчезнувшее из выдачи запроса, помечается is_active = 0 (вероятно, продано) и воскресает при возврате;
  • PriceTracker.price_drops() — объявления с упавшей ценой (первая против последней фиксации);
  • экспорт в CSV/JSON.

Идентичность объявления (fingerprint) больше не зависит от цены: ad_id → url → title|city|query, поэтому изменение цены — это история одного объявления, а не новое объявление.

docs.title: CLI
docs.text:
aios olx collect --query "лобове скло" --max-cards 50   # сбор через ADB
aios olx stats --query "лобове скло"                    # статистика рынка
aios olx recommend --query "лобове скло" --price 9000 --title "Скло BMW X3"
aios olx export --format csv --output ads.csv           # экспорт
aios olx history --fingerprint ab12cd34ef56gh78         # история цен
aios olx drops --query "лобове скло"                    # падения цен

docs.title: Парсинг сторінки оголошення — AdDetailParser
docs.text: Ціна, параметри (Стан, доставка), опис, продавець (ім'я/тип/на OLX з), місто, лічильник переглядів, дата публікації. REST: POST /olx/detail.

docs.title: Особисті чати — OLXMessenger
docs.text:
• ChatListParser: перелік чатів (співрозмовник, оголошення, сніпет, непрочитані, координати тапу).
  • ChatViewParser: напрямок повідомлень за стороною екрана.
  • ReplySuggester: чернетки відповідей (актуальність, торг з мін. порогом, зустріч, привітання).
  • Захист: відповідь спочатку падає в olx_outbox; на пристрій уходить тільки з auto_send=True або явним флашем (POST /olx/outbox/send).
  • REST: GET /olx/chats, POST /olx/chats/reply, GET /olx/outbox, POST /olx/outbox/send, POST /olx/outbox/cancel.
  • Кирилиця на реальному пристрої потребує ADBKeyBoard-IME.

docs.title: Контроль своїх оголошень — OwnAdsTracker
docs.text: Парсер «Мої оголошення» (перегляди/обрані/повідомлення/статус), снапшоти з дельтами лічильників, stagnant() — застояні оголошення. REST: GET/POST /olx/own*.

docs.title: Покращення і перевикладання — promotion.py
docs.text:
• AdImprover: ключові слова в заголовок, ціна проти медіани, доповнення опису.
  • RepostPlanner: рішення про перевикладання (вік ≥ 3 дн., < 1 перегляду/день, пікові години 18:00–21:00).
  • Reposter: DRY-RUN за замовчуванням, виконання тільки з confirm=True. ⚠️ Перевикладання може суперечити правилам OLX щодо дублів — первинне призначення модуля: рекомендації + ручне підтвердження.

docs.title: Сповіщення — notifier.py
docs.text: Вебхуки (Slack/Discord/Telegram Bot API): падіння цін конкурентів і застій своїх оголошень. REST: POST /olx/notify.

docs.title: MCP
docs.text: olx_market_stats, olx_listing_recommend, olx_price_drops (тільки читання, через ConstitutionGuard).

docs.title: Профіль і налаштування
docs.text: ProfileParser читає поля профілю (ім'я, телефон, місто, про себе) та перемикачі налаштувань; ProfileEditor готує зміни (dry-run → _pending_* у kv-сховищі, пристрій тільки з confirm=True).

docs.title: Стеження за конкурентами — від своїх оголошень
docs.text: CompetitiveWatch виводить пошуковий запит із заголовка свого оголошення, зв'язує схожі ринкові оголошення (olx_competitor_links, оцінка Jaccard+ціна+місто), рахує дешевших конкурентів і цінову позицію (ранг серед подібних).

docs.title: Радник стратегії
docs.text:
• advise_actions(): KEEP / EDIT_PRICE / EDIT_CONTENT / REPOST / PROMOTE з пріоритетами й поясненнями по кожному своєму оголошенню.
  • advise_new_listings(): активні ніші без покриття портфоліо — цільова ціна й стартовий заголовок із ринкових ключових слів.
  • REST: GET /olx/advisor (?new=1).

docs.title: Бутстрап свіжого сервера
docs.text: aios olx bootstrap — друкує повний план (apt → Python deps → platform-tools → ADBKeyBoard → SDK → образ Android 34 → headless AVD aios-olx → налаштування пристрою); --execute — виконує. Обгортка: tools/olx_bootstrap.sh. Перевірка готовності: aios olx doctor або GET /olx/doctor — чекліст із підказками виправлення.

docs.title: Обхід портфеля конкурента (2026-07-21)
docs.text:
На сторінці оголошення OLX показує блок «Інші оголошення користувача» — усього портфеля продавця. parse_seller_ads() розбирає цей блок з UI-дампа (захисти: наявність заголовка блока + виключення переглянутого оголошення за URL/ad-id), а CompetitiveWatch.observe_seller_ads():

  1. зберігає всі картки конкурента як ринкові спостереження (історія цін працює і для них);
  2. зв'язує з моїм оголошенням лише достатньо схожі (поріг link_score) — «сусідній» товар того ж продавця не змішується з прямими конкурентами;

  3. повторне сканування тієї самої сторінки не створює дублікатів.

  4. REST: POST /api/v1/modules/olx/competitive/seller-scan {fingerprint, xml, viewed_url?, viewed_ad_id?}.

  5. CLI: aios olx competitive-seller dump.xml --fingerprint <fp> [--viewed-ad-id z7kLq].

docs.title: Мультипрофільність: платформи й акаунти (2026-07-21)
docs.text:
Архітектура «платформа → профілі» (aios_core/platforms/): реєстр дескрипторів платформ + реєстр профілів-акаунтів. Кожен профіль (olx:work) має ізольоване сховище data/olx/<profile>.sqlite і прив'язку до пристрою (device_serial → adb -s <serial>, паралельна робота емуляторів). Розв'язання профілю: --profile/?profile= → AIOS_PROFILE → default реєстру → вбудований legacy default (olx_ads.sqlite, повна зворотна сумісність).

  • CLI: aios platforms, aios profiles list|add|show|remove|set-default, усі olx-команди з --profile; явний --db обходить реєстр.
  • REST: /api/v1/platforms, /api/v1/profiles*, будь-який модульний маршрут з ?profile=<name>; невідомий профіль → 400.
  • Масштабування на 10000+ застосунків: docs/PLATFORMS_SCALING.md.

docs.title: Scaffold, Fleet, PoolMonitor (2026-07-21)
docs.text: aios platforms scaffold --name X --package ua.x.app генерує скелет нової платформи (YAML-дескриптор + модуль зі storage-нащадком OLXStorage + smoke-тест). ensure_device() (CLI aios devices ensure --profile olx:work) гарантує профілю пристрій: аренда з пулу, а за нестачі — створення AVD, запуск headless-емулятора й реєстрація в пулі. PoolMonitor (CLI aios devices monitor) — демон heartbeats: adb devices → heartbeat + reap мовчазних у offline.

docs.title: TikTok — onboarding (alpha.21)
docs.text: Onboarding-пакет: platforms/tiktok.yaml + aios_core/modules/tiktok/ (TikTokStorage, TikTokMessenger, TikTokBootstrap). Compliance: autopost_allowed: false, messenger: approval-only, collector: true — платформа участвует в generic ReelsCollector (reels-драйвер) после калибровки видео-ленсты.

docs.title: 1. Установка
docs.text:
aios platforms fetch-apk com.zhiliaoapp.musically
adb -s <SERIAL> install apks/com.zhiliaoapp.musically*.apk
aios platforms doctor --platform tiktok --serial <SERIAL>

docs.title: 2. Live-калибровка hints (видео-лента + tab-bar)
docs.text:
aios platforms doctor --platform tiktok --calibrate-recipe

Снимите дампы главного экрана (tab-bar) и ленты:

adb -s <SERIAL> shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tiktok-navigation.xml
adb -s <SERIAL> pull /sdcard/tiktok-navigation.xml platforms/
adb -s <SERIAL> shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tiktok-cards.xml
adb -s <SERIAL> pull /sdcard/tiktok-cards.xml platforms/
aios platforms calibrate --platform tiktok \
  --dump platforms/tiktok-cards.xml \
  --navigation platforms/tiktok-navigation.xml --write
aios platforms marker-check --platform tiktok \
  --dump platforms/tiktok-cards.xml     # baseline для drift-регрессии

docs.title: 3. Сбор видео-ленсты (read-only)
docs.text:
aios platforms reels --platform tiktok --db data/tiktok.sqlite --max 50
# или с авто-переходом на таб reels и webhook-алёртами:
aios platforms reels --platform tiktok --open-tab \
  --webhook http://127.0.0.1:9999/hook

Сбор публичного контента read-only; Direct/guarded-мессенджер — после калибровки parser_hints.messenger, отправки только через outbox.

docs.title: Viber — onboarding (alpha.21)
docs.text: Onboarding-пакет: platforms/viber.yaml + aios_core/modules/viber/ (ViberStorage, ViberMessenger — guarded HintsMessenger с deep-link viber://chats, ViberBootstrap). Compliance: autopost_allowed: false, messenger: approval-only, collector: false.

docs.title: 1. Установка
docs.text:
aios platforms fetch-apk com.viber.voip
adb -s <SERIAL> install apks/com.viber.voip*.apk
aios viber doctor --serial <SERIAL>

docs.title: 2. Live-калибровка hints
docs.text:
aios platforms doctor --platform viber --calibrate-recipe

Откройте чаты экрана Viber, снимите дамп и запишите маркеры:

adb -s <SERIAL> shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/viber-messenger.xml
adb -s <SERIAL> pull /sdcard/viber-messenger.xml \
  platforms/viber-messenger.xml
aios platforms calibrate --platform viber \
  --messages platforms/viber-messenger.xml --write
aios viber doctor --serial <SERIAL>   # hints_messenger → ok

docs.title: 3. Guarded-работа
docs.text:
aios viber chats --db data/viber.sqlite
aios viber dm-send --chat '<chat>' --text 'Текст' --db data/viber.sqlite
aios viber dm-outbox --db data/viber.sqlite
aios viber dm-flush --db data/viber.sqlite

Все отправки — только через очередь одобрения (outbox).

docs.title: WhatsApp — onboarding (alpha.21)
docs.text: Onboarding-пакет: platforms/whatsapp.yaml + aios_core/modules/whatsapp/ (WhatsAppStorage, WhatsAppMessenger — guarded HintsMessenger, WhatsAppBootstrap). Compliance: autopost_allowed: false, messenger: approval-only, collector: false.

docs.title: 1. Подготовка устройства
docs.text:
aios platforms fetch-apk com.whatsapp          # apkeep → apks/
adb -s <SERIAL> install apks/com.whatsapp*.apk
aios whatsapp doctor --serial <SERIAL>

docs.title: 2. Live-калибровка hints (on-device)
docs.text:
parser_hints честно пустые после установки — они снимаются с живого устройства, а не выдумываются. Готовый сценарий печатает:

aios platforms doctor --platform whatsapp --calibrate-recipe

По шагам рецепта: откройте инбокс/чат и снимите дамп:

adb -s <SERIAL> shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/whatsapp-messenger.xml
adb -s <SERIAL> pull /sdcard/whatsapp-messenger.xml \
  platforms/whatsapp-messenger.xml
aios platforms calibrate --platform whatsapp \
  --messages platforms/whatsapp-messenger.xml --write
aios whatsapp doctor --serial <SERIAL>   # hints_messenger → ok

docs.title: 3. Guarded-работа
docs.text:
aios whatsapp chats --db data/whatsapp.sqlite
aios whatsapp dm-send --chat '<chat>' --text 'Здравствуйте!' \
  --db data/whatsapp.sqlite               # → outbox (очередь одобрения)
aios whatsapp dm-outbox --db data/whatsapp.sqlite
aios whatsapp dm-flush --db data/whatsapp.sqlite   # после одобрения

Ничего не отправляется в обход outbox; --auto-send у dm-send — явное сознательное исключение.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
The Architecture Evolution Agent is responsible for continuous improvement of AIOS itself.

Its task is not only to maintain the current architecture, but to analyze, research and propose better designs based on accumulated experience.

docs.title: Core Mission
docs.text:
Observe AIOS
     ↓
Analyze Performance
     ↓
Research Alternatives
     ↓
Design Improvements
     ↓
Test Changes
     ↓
Adopt Successful Evolution

docs.title: Responsibilities
docs.text:
The agent monitors:

  • system architecture
  • worker efficiency
  • resource usage
  • API performance
  • skill quality
  • memory growth
  • orchestration strategies

docs.title: Research Requirement
docs.text:
Before major architectural decisions AIOS should analyze:

  • scientific publications
  • GitHub projects
  • engineering practices
  • open source architectures
  • community experience
  • alternative approaches

Knowledge must be evaluated before integration.

docs.title: Improvement Cycle
docs.text:
Current Architecture
        ↓
Observed Problems
        ↓
Research
        ↓
Proposal
        ↓
Experiment
        ↓
Metrics Comparison
        ↓
Architecture Update

docs.title: Experimental Approach
docs.text:
Improvements should be tested safely:

  • isolated environments
  • feature branches
  • simulations
  • A/B comparisons
  • rollback capability

docs.title: Interaction With Other Agents
docs.text:
Works with:

  • Orchestrator Agent
  • Documentation Agent
  • Skill Engine
  • Testing Engine
  • Memory System

docs.title: Long-Term Goal
docs.text: AIOS should continuously improve its own efficiency, reliability and intelligence without requiring complete redesign by humans.

docs.title: Core Principle
docs.text: The system that manages intelligence must itself be capable of learning and evolving.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text:
Define how AIOS manages distributed workers, test cells, application instances and specialized capabilities.

The system must scale horizontally instead of depending on one overloaded execution node.

docs.title: Worker Model
docs.text:
A worker is any resource capable of producing useful execution results.

Examples:

  • Android emulator
  • physical device
  • Docker container
  • remote server
  • temporary test environment
  • specialized API worker

docs.title: Worker Lifecycle
docs.text:
Registration
    ↓
Capability Discovery
    ↓
Task Assignment
    ↓
Execution
    ↓
Metrics Collection
    ↓
Experience Reporting
    ↓
Skill Improvement

docs.title: Orchestrator Responsibilities
docs.text:
The Orchestrator manages:

  • worker availability
  • task routing
  • priority decisions
  • load balancing
  • capability matching
  • failure recovery
  • optimization strategies

docs.title: Capability Federation
docs.text:
Multiple incomplete workers can form one complete capability.

Example:

Worker A
- authentication
- profile access

Worker B
- search
- public data

Worker C
- messaging

        ↓

Unified AIOS API

docs.title: Dynamic Task Distribution
docs.text:
When a request arrives:

External Request
        ↓
Orchestrator Analysis
        ↓
Capability Selection
        ↓
Worker Allocation
        ↓
Execution
        ↓
Result Aggregation

docs.title: Cooperative Workers
docs.text:
A worker may request assistance from another worker when:

  • required capability is unavailable
  • another worker has better context
  • execution can be optimized
  • resource usage can be reduced

docs.title: Temporary Workers
docs.text:
Short-lived resources are valid participants.

Example:

docs.text:
Every phase must produce:

docs.title: 1. Price Prediction ML Engine (aios_core/price_prediction_ml.py)
docs.text:
Full-featured ML-style price prediction without external dependencies:

  • Polynomial Regression — degree 1 (linear), 2 (quadratic), 3 (cubic) via least-squares fitting
  • Moving Average Models — SMA, WMA, EMA with configurable windows
  • Ensemble Predictor — averages multiple models weighted by confidence
  • Trend Detection — UP, DOWN, STABLE, VOLATILE with automatic detection
  • PricePredictionEngine — high-level API: predict(), predict_best(), predict_all()
  • Gaussian Elimination — pure Python solver for normal equations
  • Confidence Scoring — based on MSE, data points, model fit quality
  • Negative Price Clamping — predicted prices never go below 0

docs.title: 2. Product Image Comparison (aios_core/image_comparison.py)
docs.text:
Perceptual hashing for cross-platform duplicate detection:

  • Average Hash (aHash) — fastest, coarse similarity (8×8 → 64-bit)
  • Difference Hash (dHash) — gradient-based, better edge detection (9×8 → 64-bit)
  • Perceptual Hash (pHash) — DCT-based, best accuracy (32×32 → low-frequency 64-bit)
  • Color Histogram Comparison — RGB binning with intersection similarity
  • ImageComparisonEngine — composite scoring (hash + color), duplicate detection, best-match search
  • Pixel Resampling — block averaging for arbitrary-size images
  • 2D DCT — pure Python Discrete Cosine Transform for pHash

docs.title: 3. Fleet Scheduler (aios_core/fleet_scheduler.py)
docs.text:
Multi-device orchestration for parallel scraping:

  • Device Management — register, heartbeat, health monitoring, auto-offline detection
  • Task Scheduling — 4 policies: round-robin, least-busy, priority-first, random
  • Priority System — CRITICAL → LOW → MAINTENANCE with queue ordering
  • Automatic Retry — failed tasks re-queued with configurable max retries
  • Cooldown Mechanism — 3+ failures → device cooldown (configurable duration)
  • Queue Processing — pending tasks auto-assigned when devices become available
  • Load Balancing — rebalance from overloaded (>80%) to underloaded (<30%) devices
  • Fleet Statistics — utilization, reliability, queue depth, success/fail counts

docs.title: 1. A/B Testing Engine (aios_core/ab_testing_engine.py)
docs.text:
Full-featured A/B testing for scraping strategy comparison:

  • Experiment Lifecycle — draft → running → paused → completed → analyzed
  • Variant Tracking — observations, success rates, confidence weights
  • Statistical Tests — Chi-square for rate metrics, Welch's t-test for mean metrics
  • Significance Analysis — p-value computation, confidence intervals, lift calculation
  • Auto-Completion — automatically stop experiment when statistical significance reached
  • Normal CDF Approximation — Abramowitz & Stegun polynomial approximation
  • Experiment Registry — list, filter, cancel, pause experiments

docs.title: 2. Knowledge Graph (aios_core/knowledge_graph.py)
docs.text:
In-memory knowledge graph for product/seller relationships:

  • Triple Storage — subject → predicate → object with weights and metadata
  • API-Compatible Methods — add_node, add_relation, get_node, find_nodes, neighbors, path
  • Neighborhood Queries — find related entities, multi-hop neighbors
  • Path Finding — BFS shortest path with weight and confidence tracking
  • Inference Rules — chain inference (sold_by+located_in → located_in, etc.)
  • Entity Types — products, sellers, platforms, cities, categories
  • Upsert Support — adding same node updates label/properties
  • DB Compatibility — accepts db parameter (stored for future persistence)

docs.title: 3. Auto-Tuning Engine (aios_core/auto_tuning.py)
docs.text:
Dynamic scraping parameter optimization:

  • Parameter Registry — INT, FLOAT, BOOL, CHOICE types with ranges
  • Grid Search — exhaustive parameter space exploration
  • Random Search — random sampling of configurations
  • Hill Climbing — local perturbation around current best
  • Adaptive (Bayesian-style) — 70% explore, 30% random, decreasing perturbation
  • Performance Feedback — success rate, latency, items, errors → composite score
  • Automatic Best Tracking — update best params when better configuration found
  • Scoring Functions — default weighted (success0.5 + latency0.2 + items*0.3) or custom

docs.title: 🎯 Executive Summary
docs.text:
Release v10.16.0 is a major milestone in strengthening the AIOS Core Architecture and Cloud Infrastructure. We successfully expanded critical modules into production-grade robust implementations, achieved 100% test pass rate (resolving critical P0 audit failures), and deployed a complete Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) setup for AWS.

We are officially running >2700 passing tests with 0 failures.

docs.title: 🚀 Core Expansions & Enhancements
docs.text:
• AI Safety Framework (ai_safety.py): Expanded to >230 lines. Added BiasSafety, PrivacySafety (PII protection), AdversarialSafety (Prompt injection protection), and ResourceSafety. Introduced a global threshold and system health monitoring logic.
  • Predictive Autonomy (predictive_autonomy.py): Expanded to >200 lines. Introduced EnvironmentContextAnalyzer (prod vs dev), ResourceImpactPredictor (CPU/Mem forecasting), and AgentHistoryAnalyzer for dynamic failure risk prediction based on historic capabilities.
  • Planetary Federation (planetary_federation.py): Expanded to >210 lines. Implemented Delay-Tolerant Networking (DTN) using the Bundle Protocol for deep space routing. Added energy consumption & solar recharge simulations for lunar/orbital edge nodes, along with an experimental QuantumLinkManager.
  • Neuromorphic Matrix (neuromorphic_matrix.py): Expanded to >240 lines. Integrated advanced IzhikevichNeuron models for burst/chatter simulation, LateralInhibition (WTA), and an asynchronous NeuromorphicEventRouter (AER) to replace standard weight iteration.

docs.title: AIOS Release Notes — v10.17.0 (Next-Gen Memory & Substrate UI)
🎯 Executive Summary
docs.text: Following the massive stability and infrastructure improvements in v10.16.0, release v10.17.0 focuses on scaling agent memory capabilities and enhancing deep-tech observability. We introduced native vector compression for long-term agent memory, deployed a visual substrate convergence router, and hardened our AWS EKS monitoring stack.

docs.title: 🧠 Agent Memory Optimization
docs.text:
• Vector Compression (PQ): Implemented Product Quantization compression natively in pure Python within vector_store.py. This scales down memory consumption of high-dimensional embeddings by ~75% via uint8 codebook quantization.
  • Semantic Search Integration: MemoryManager now performs hybrid semantic searches out-of-the-box. Any stored memory with an embedding metadata tag is automatically indexed into the compressed vector store and can be retrieved using the new semantic_search() method.

docs.title: AIOS Release Notes — v10.18.0 (Async Horizon & Federated Edge)
🎯 Executive Summary
docs.text: Release v10.18.0 delivers the ultimate scaling architecture for AIOS. We successfully migrated all core storage layers to full native asynchronous execution and established the foundation for decentralized, privacy-preserving AI through WebAssembly sandboxing and Advanced Federated Learning.

docs.title: ⚡ Core Async Architecture
docs.text:
• True Asyncpg & Aiosqlite Migration: Completely rewrote the AsyncDatabase wrapper. It now drops the blocking asyncio.to_thread facade in favor of native non-blocking database drivers.
  • Dynamic Query Translation: Implemented a real-time dialect translator that seamlessly maps SQLite ? bindings to PostgreSQL $1, $2 parameters, ensuring total cross-database compatibility without changing application code.
  • Uncompromised Performance: Maintains extreme throughput (~234,000+ OPS) while eliminating thread-pool starvation under massive I/O loads.

docs.title: 🛡️ WebAssembly Plugin Sandbox
docs.text:
• Wasm Runtime Integration: Introduced WasmRuntime into the Plugin Manager (v5.0).
  • Secure Isolation: External and untrusted plugins can now be compiled to .wasm and executed with zero access to the host's memory, filesystem, or network.
  • Boundary Hooks: Native AIOS events can now trigger Wasm hooks, dynamically serializing payloads across the WebAssembly execution boundary.

docs.title: 🌐 Edge Federated Learning (FL)
docs.text:
• Asynchronous Aggregation (FedAsync): Replaced strict synchronous rounds. The coordinator now gracefully blends stale model gradients from lagging edge devices based on a time-decay alpha factor.
  • Secure Aggregation (SecAgg): Server no longer sees raw client updates. Gradients are mathematically masked on the client and only unmasked upon full aggregation.
  • Local Differential Privacy (LDP): Enabled customizable Gaussian noise injection at the device level, constrained by a strict Epsilon budget.
  • Hardware-Aware Client Selection: The FL coordinator profiles nodes and selects participants dynamically based on compute capacity (GFLOPS) and remaining battery life.

🎯 Executive Summary
docs.text: Release v10.20.0 bridges the gap between digital systems and human-like perception, while extending AIOS's distributed architecture to planetary scales.
